observations: Blue cabinet-style industrial machine with two front doors open, revealing internal mechanism and tooling.
Control panel with buttons and a small display mounted on the right door.
A watermark reading 'JENABSON FACTORY' is overlaid on the image.
Background shows what appears to be a warehouse/showroom with other equipment and a truck.
No brand name, model number, or capacity plate is legible anywhere on the machine body or panel.
No bottles, molds, or output samples are shown being produced.

identity.kind: automatic plastic bottle (PET) blow molding machine

claims.claim: Automatic Plastic Bottle Making Machine used in production to make pet plastic bottles of different sizes
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a closed-cabinet machine with no running demonstration, output samples, or legible spec plate to confirm automation level, PET compatibility, or size range.

risks.risk: Unknown cavity count / output capacity (a major price driver for blow molding machines)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the machine's nameplate/spec sticker showing model, cavity number, and bottle size range
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest-capacity single-cavity class, since capacity cannot be confirmed

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (heater bands, control board, hydraulics/pneumatics could be faulty)
risks.proof: Video of the machine powered on and completing a blow cycle, producing a bottle

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete molds/tooling needed to operate
risks.proof: Photo of accompanying mold set(s) included in the sale

risks.risk: Age and usage history (hours run, maintenance record)
risks.proof: Photo of a logbook, invoice, or production date sticker

risks.risk: Electrical compatibility (voltage/phase) with Nigerian industrial supply
risks.proof: Photo of the electrical rating plate
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible conversion cost needed

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the machine's nameplate/spec sticker (model, cavity count, voltage, bottle size range)
Video of the machine powered on and cycling, ideally producing a bottle
Photo of any molds included with the sale
Photo of invoice, purchase date, or maintenance log
response.reason: The machine type can be identified generally, but no model, cavity count, or capacity is legible, and these drive the price by orders of magnitude; without that or a working demonstration, even a worst-case price cannot be set.
